about: BAAHEIN KHOL pose deck (owner, 3 Nov 2026): Shah Rukh Khan's poses from public photos (DuckDuckGo image search, 62 searches, 3 Nov 2026), each checked to be SRK by face matching and by eye. kp = his 17 body points on the hosted image (MoveNet); the game compares the fan's arm angles with them on the fan's own device. Difficulty: from how far the arms are from resting, how lopsided and how bent (Easy / Medium / Hard / Legendary by share of the deck). source = the page the photo came from.
